scope: Single chart station, synthetic B-mode feature generator and actual DMP short pose commands. Tests learned A local response with five-frame public LA gate; no real B-mode, SMPL-X production atlas, QP/dIRD, or B planning claim.

information_boundary.public: Generic one-station chart template, manually specified four-mode plus broad-tail prior with correlated five-control curve residuals, public body surface context c, current probe pose, commanded DMP, unique timestamped noisy image frames and posterior.
information_boundary.private: Held-out patient mode, correlated curve controls, individual response E, true vessel/false-source identity, future images and audit LA.
information_boundary.trained_response_input: Only public c and commanded pose difference, plus visible source-world before/after image measurements in training. No hidden target position, true J, E, future frame or test world ID.
information_boundary.policy_counterfactual: With same public history, prior, pose and frozen model, changing hidden patient gives identical next action. Different legal prior weights may change action.

template_prior.fifth_broad_mode: zero-mean location/angle, SD 0.035m/0.25rad, coherent curve not pointwise white noise
template_prior.five_control_curve: correlated Gaussian residual controls at chart s=[0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7], SD=0.003m, adjacent correlation=0.65; shared registration SD=0.002m; piecewise cubic Hermite at station; no test-specific anchor
template_prior.patient_source: independent split world sampling; public template frozen before world generation
template_prior.limitation: only one station queried, so not a whole-leg atlas or 15mm longitudinal navigation coverage

response.public_context_c: three exogenous visible body/surface features each Uniform[-1,1] in train/test; shift Uniform[-1.3,1.3]
response.truth: z=z0-J(c,E)q; J=I+0.45[[c0,0.5c1],[-0.35c1,c2]]+E, hidden E~Normal(0,0.04) entrywise (shift SD 0.08); G_exact uses J=I
response.learned_residual: ridge reg 0.001 on interactions c_j*delta_q and delta_q, trained on public visible-before/after differences; frozen before test; no hidden labels
response.online_jacobian: Broyden rank-one update from two successive publicly detected image blocks, starts I, no extra probes; all action/observation/time budgets same
test_metrics: held-out response RMSE on observable transitions
response.negative_control: G_exact uses J=I and independent worlds/noise; learned advantage should vanish or reverse
response.constant_jacobian_baseline: same visible source-world pairs and ridge 0.001, fit a constant 2x2 J without public c; held-out action value tests conditional benefit

actions.family: 1 generic center survey + 4 template lane/tangent branches x lateral offsets [-0.010,0,+0.010]m x yaw offsets [-0.10,0,+0.10]rad; 37 unique candidate poses at fixed chart station
actions.DMP: fit_discrete_dmp and rollout 21 returned motion samples from current actual command endpoint to candidate; render at actual final DMP sample, not desired endpoint
actions.duration: from peak sampled step speed limits, not mean length
actions.repeat_action: disallowed unless all candidates exhausted; same rule all methods
actions.known_reference_velocity: finite derivative of chosen commanded DMP pose only; hidden vessel velocity never given

image_stream.contact_truth: abs(probe_y)<=0.030m; public contact has 1% bit flip
image_stream.missing_contract: If not detected, center/angle/length/depth/identity all null; no hidden crop
image_stream.scope_note: visible_length is a declared synthetic image feature proxy; not actual 3D visible tube segment or B-mode image

public_LA_verifier.requires: five consecutive new timestamped frames spanning >=0.5s; each visible, segment length>=0.015m, abs center<=0.002m, abs axial angle<=10deg, identity score>=0.75, contact true
public_LA_verifier.stop: public verifier only; audit failure does not trigger retry

independent_audit.requires: same five physical frames with true target source, true geometric segment length>=0.015m, true abs center<=0.002m, true abs axial angle<=10deg, true contact and acquisition visible; hidden world only used here and renderer
independent_audit.scope_note: independent hidden-geometry check of the synthetic feature proxy; no real image/3D tube verifier

policy.same_budget: same 37 candidates, 6 action and 30 frame maximum, same 60s cap, motion/hold/planning charged
policy.decision: myopic predicted probability of public LA with small detection coverage term and nominal motion cost; posterior updated per unique frame, fixed particle prior common across methods
policy.belief: 80 frozen generic correlated-curve particles (16 per mode incl broad) each retain sampled persistent 2x2 E nuisance and z0 offset; unique frame likelihood updates. Finite-particle and response-model mismatch remain; no posterior coverage/calibration claim.
policy.B_status: deferred until learned A interface passes honest checks

reporting: Paired world counts and bootstrap descriptive 95% CI; all failures retained. L0 synthetic only; no model/LA result claimed before independent run.
